title: A longer heated rod
hook: Change original rod length and predict length change.
misconception: length change stays fixed when original rod length doubles.
objective: Apply ΔL = αL₀ΔT to compare length change when original rod length changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With the same material and temperature change in the linear expansion regime, ΔL = αL₀ΔT. When original rod length doubles, length change becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model ΔL = αL₀ΔT; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider the same material and temperature change in the linear expansion regime, with a nonzero initial result. If original rod length triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on length change?
recall.why: Apply ΔL = αL₀ΔT under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
